about.summary: What is Npcap? Why it's needed and what to consider

what.title: What it is
what.body: Npcap is the Nmap Project's packet capture library for Windows, built on a custom Windows kernel driver and libpcap. Its drivers are signed by the Nmap Project and countersigned by Microsoft.

why.title: Why Aion Companion uses it
why.body: Live capture reads AION 2's game traffic through it to fill in the DPS meter, Group, trackers and the pet radar. The capture feature is read-only: it does not inject game packets or change game files.

source.title: Where it comes from
source.body: Get it only from npcap.com, the official site. Its installer is signed by Nmap Software LLC; check that Windows names that publisher before you allow it. Keep it updated for its security and stability fixes.

risks.title: What to consider
risks.body: A kernel driver runs with full system privileges and can see network traffic from every program on this PC, not only the game, and so can other software that uses it. Like any driver, it can affect stability, and installing it can require restarting Windows. Aion Companion makes no promise about how the game's publisher views third-party tools.

choice.title: It is your choice
choice.body: Npcap is optional. Saved logs and reports, Replay, reminders, Timers and backups work without it, and you can uninstall it from Windows' installed apps at any time.

githubCli.name: GitHub CLI
githubCli.hint: Only for automatic updates from the private repository. The app and its installer run without it.
